decision.summary: A multi-sample downward offset in E (≈−8 MAD) initiates at index 442, persists through 447, and shows partial recovery starting at 448. Concurrent smaller transients appear in N and U, supporting a coherent event. The return is not fully observed before the allowed context ends at 485, preventing confirmation of a complete temporary interval.

intervals.observation: E-axis drops sharply from ~−2 to ~−10 MAD over indices 442–445, sustained through 446–447; N shows concurrent smaller negative offset (~−1 to −2 MAD); U shows minor transient dip (~−1 MAD). Return begins at 448 but is incomplete within allowed context (ends at 485), so status is uncertain.
